description: Add computeGraphCID() utility — compute CIDv1 of JSONL graph files
steps: Create packages/amcp-memory/src/graph-cid.ts (<100 lines) with computeGraphCID(filePath: string): Promise<string>
Use multiformats library (add to package.json dependencies: 'multiformats': '^13.0.0')

Read JSONL file, compute SHA256 hash of content, create CID using multiformats: import { CID } from 'multiformats/cid'; import * as raw from 'multiformats/codecs/raw'; import { sha256 } from 'multiformats/hashes/sha2'
CID format: raw codec (0x55), sha256 hash (0x12), CIDv1, base32 encoding (produces 'bafkrei...' prefix)
Handle edge cases: missing file returns null, empty file returns CID of empty string, validate each line is valid JSON before hashing
Export from packages/amcp-memory/src/index.ts: export { computeGraphCID } from './graph-cid'

description: Define ontology entity types — TypeScript types for typed graphs
steps: Create packages/amcp-memory/src/ontology-types.ts (<200 lines) with entity and relation type definitions

Base types: Entity { id: string; type: EntityType; properties: Record<string,any>; created: Date; updated: Date }, Relation { from_id: string; relation_type: RelationType; to_id: string; properties?: Record<string,any> }
Entity types enum: Person, Organization, Project, Task, Goal, Event, Location, Document, Message, Note, Account, Credential, Action, Policy
Relation types enum: has_owner, owns, has_task, part_of, member_of, blocks, depends_on, mentions, references
Concrete types: PersonEntity extends Entity { type: 'Person'; properties: { name: string; email?: string; phone?: string; notes?: string } }
Schema constraints interface: EntityConstraint { type: EntityType; required_properties: string[]; forbidden_properties?: string[]; acyclic_relations?: RelationType[] }
Export all types from packages/amcp-memory/src/index.ts
Verify: TypeScript strict mode passes, all entity types have proper type safety

description: Add validateOntologySchema() function — validate JSONL graph files
steps: Create packages/amcp-memory/src/validate-ontology.ts (<150 lines) with validateOntologySchema(filePath: string): Promise<ValidationResult>
ValidationResult type: { valid: boolean; entity_count: number; relation_count: number; errors: string[] }

Validation checks: 1) Each line is valid JSON, 2) Each object has 'type' field (entity or relation), 3) Entities have required fields (id, type, properties, created, updated), 4) Relations have required fields (from_id, relation_type, to_id), 5) Relation integrity (from_id and to_id reference existing entity IDs), 6) Acyclic check for 'blocks' and 'depends_on' relations (detect cycles via DFS)
Build entity index while parsing: Map<string, Entity> for O(1) relation validation
Cycle detection: for each 'blocks' relation, run DFS from to_id, error if reaches from_id
Return detailed errors: 'Line 42: Relation from_id='task-123' references non-existent entity', 'Line 58: Circular dependency detected: task-A blocks task-B blocks task-A'
Export from packages/amcp-memory/src/index.ts
Verify: validateOntologySchema() rejects invalid graphs, accepts valid graphs, detects circular dependencies

description: SOUL drift detection utilities — computeSoulHash(), detectSoulDrift() with severity classification

detectSoulDrift(previousHash: string, currentHash: string, previousContent: string, currentContent: string): DriftResult
DriftResult type: { drifted: boolean; severity: 'none' | 'minor' | 'moderate' | 'major'; lines_changed: number; diff_snippet?: string }
Severity rules: 0 lines = none, 1-4 = minor, 5-20 = moderate, >20 = major
Use diff algorithm: import { diffLines } from 'diff' (add 'diff' to package.json dependencies), count changed lines (insertions + deletions)
Include first 5 lines of unified diff in diff_snippet for logging
Export from packages/amcp-core/src/index.ts

description: Reconstruction sequence utilities — standardize memory loading order API
steps: Create packages/amcp-recovery/src/reconstruction.ts (<150 lines) defining canonical reconstruction sequence
ReconstructionStep enum: SOUL = 0, USER = 1, ONTOLOGY_SCHEMA = 2, ONTOLOGY_GRAPH = 3, CURATED_MEMORY = 4, EPHEMERAL_NOTES = 5, TOOLS = 6, SEAM = 7
loadMemorySequence(checkpointPath: string, outputDir: string): Promise<ReconstructionProgress> — orchestrates loading in canonical order
ReconstructionProgress type: { current_step: ReconstructionStep; steps_completed: ReconstructionStep[]; seam_crossed: boolean; errors: string[] }

Implementation: 1) Load SOUL.md -> 2) Load USER.md -> 3) Load ontology schema (if exists) -> 4) Validate and load graph.jsonl -> 5) Load MEMORY.md -> 6) Load daily notes -> 7) Load TOOLS.md -> 8) Set seam_crossed: true
Each step validates before proceeding: missing SOUL.md fails immediately (identity required), missing ontology skips steps 3-4 (optional)
Export from packages/amcp-recovery/src/index.ts
Verify: loadMemorySequence() follows canonical order, seam_crossed only true after all steps complete, missing optional files don't block progression
